functionalRequirements.title: Core Functionality
functionalRequirements.description:
The pilot project is: aidm-pilot-task-queue
Purpose:
A reliable prioritized in-memory task queue engine supporting:
- FIFO/priority scheduling
- task leasing
- TTL expiration
- deterministic state snapshots
- JSON serialization/deserialization

The eventual pilot is intended to be a small, real, independently versioned TypeScript project.

functionalRequirements.title: Domain Models & Schema Validation
functionalRequirements.description: Type definitions and schema validation for TaskItem, TaskPriority, QueueConfig, and TaskLease.
businessRules: QueueConfig specifies default lease durations, TTL limits, and queue capacities
TaskLease tracks active leases with leaseholder identity and expiration timestamp

functionalRequirements.title: Deterministic State Serialization & Snapshots
functionalRequirements.description: Deterministic JSON state serialization, deserialization, and schema validation of queue state snapshots.
businessRules: Deserialization validates state against schema before restoring in-memory queue
JSON serialization must be strictly deterministic (reproducible ordering)

functionalRequirements.title: Prioritized In-Memory Queue Operations
functionalRequirements.description: Queue operations including enqueue, dequeue, peek, lease, release, and expireStale.
businessRules: FIFO ordering strictly enforced within the same TaskPriority level
Leased tasks are hidden from dequeue until released or expired
expireStale reclaims expired leases and evicts TTL-exceeded tasks

performance: High-throughput in-memory queue operations with low algorithmic complexity
reliability: Deterministic state machine transitions, zero task loss during valid lease/release lifecycle
security: No external network exposure, isolated in-memory execution, input schema validation
availability: Always available synchronously within host process
scalability: Bounded in-memory footprint suitable for embedded Node.js library usage
usability: Idiomatic TypeScript API with strongly typed contracts and clear error handling

operationalConstraints: Modular separation of domain models, queue engine, and serialization adapters
Pure in-memory engine, no external network dependencies or external daemon connections

assumptions.statement: Persistence storage expects In-memory data structures with deterministic JSON snapshot serialization/deserialization
